mapper.insert: INSERT INTO video_resolutions (id, file_id, version, resolution, status, file_size, storage_path, error_message, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{fileId}, #{version}, #{resolution}, #{status}, #{fileSize}, #{storagePath}, #{errorMessage}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE video_resolutions SET status = #{status}, file_size = #{fileSize}, storage_path = #{storagePath}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM video_resolutions WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND version = #{version} ORDER BY resolution
